clips.title: The story
paras: The Agamand Family Sword is a tarnished ancestral blade kept inside the Agamand Family Crypt in northern Tirisfal Glades. Once a proud symbol of the wealthy mill-owning dynasty, it is sought by the Forsaken Coleman Farthing to erase the final vestiges of his former masters' legacy.

Before the Third War, the Agamand dynasty held immense wealth and influence across the rolling mills of northern Tirisfal Glades. When the Scourge swept through Lordaeron, the family met a gruesome end, their bodies raised into mindless thralls of the Lich King. Their ancestral weapons, including the ceremonial family sword, were sealed away in the Agamand Family Crypt at the northern edge of the mills. Stripping these blades from their burial racks serves not merely as looting, but as a deliberate act to break whatever memory and noble standing remains of the fallen household.
